symptom: `mxcli run --local` booted an app whose scheduled events never fired; the only trace was the runtime log line `Synchronizing scheduled events: None`, and nothing at start said so
cause: `runtimeConfigParams` builds the boot update_configuration payload without `ScheduledEventExecution`, so the runtime's own default NONE applies to every local run
insight: A setting mxcli never names is a setting the runtime decides, silently. The default belongs in the RunLocal path, not in `runtimeConfigParams`: that payload is shared with the test runner (`StartLocalApp`), where a scheduled event firing mid-run would make tests nondeterministic, and a test pins that the shared payload stays without it. Explicit `--runtime-setting` still wins because the default is only added when the key is absent. Not booted; asserted on the payload map
